findings.title: Inconsistent grading normalization in the family Frøyshov invariant

source_locations.claim: Stable Floer presentation and boundary normalization

findings.method: Analytic cohomological calculation, with assumptions checked on the supplied source and rendered evidence pages.

checks.name: Real two-plane suspension
checks.parameters: p=3, n=2, j=0, B=(BZ_3)_2, X=B×S^0, E_R=B×R^2, E_C=0, infinity section, trivial S^1 actions.
checks.assumptions: B is compact connected finite CW; fibers finite CW; fixed bundle is the compactification of the rank-zero oriented real bundle; empty complement is free; E_R oriented. The suspension has fixed level two and satisfies the same family conditions.
checks.checked_result: Relative S^1-equivariant cohomology is A before suspension and A[-2] afterward, A=H*(B×BS^1;F_3). Fixed-point restriction is identity. The degree-zero unit and degree-two Thom class are admissible, so d=0 and d=2 respectively.
checks.consequence: The raw cohomological-degree definition and printed suspension formula cannot both hold.

checks.name: Complex-line stable-presentation test
checks.parameters: j=0 over (BZ_3)_2; W=C with circle weight one and trivial Z_3 action; (I,V)=(S^0,0), (I',V')=(S^C,C); keep correction c fixed.
checks.assumptions: Both presentations represent the same stable sphere; fixed-point levels both zero. This is a formal stabilization test, not a computed manifold spectrum or actual spectral-window example.
checks.checked_result: d(S^0)=0; d(S^C)=2 via Thom degree two and Euler restriction U. Thus D(I',V')-D(I,V)=4.
checks.consequence: The plus sign fails this stable-presentation compatibility test. Interpreting dimension as complex gives three, still nonzero.

findings.alternative_readings: Subtracting fixed level repairs the first test locally but is absent from the displayed definition and does not repair the complex-line test. Changing the plus sign to minus cancels the second test locally. The report does not assert a completed global normalization repair.
findings.core_dependency: Lemma 5.15 -> boundary invariant/Corollary 5.19 -> Theorem 5.20 (explicit invocation) -> Lemma 6.1 -> final contradiction proving Theorem 1.1.
findings.impact_limit: The printed core derivation is invalid under its displayed conventions; falsity of the main infinite-order/exoticness conclusions is not established.
findings.repair_status: Local test-case repairs analytically checked; global coordinated repair unverified.

acceptance_check.claim_location: Definitions5.3,5.5 PDF pp.24-25 / printed232-233; Lemma5.15 PDF27/235; stable presentation PDF13/221 and normalization PDF30/238; dependent Theorem5.20, Lemma6.1 and final contradiction PDF30-32.
acceptance_check.hypotheses: Take p=3,n=2,j=0,B=(BZ3)_2,X=B?S0 and the trivial oriented real two-plane bundle, with E_C=0 and the infinity section. B and fibers are finite CW, the fixed bundle is the compactification of the oriented rank-zero bundle, and the complement is empty and hence free. Its real suspension satisfies the same conditions at level2.
acceptance_check.decisive_check: With A=H*(B?BS1;F3), relative equivariant cohomology is A before suspension and A[-2] afterward. Fixed-point restriction is identity, so the admissible unit and Thom classes give raw d=0 and2. Lemma5.15 predicts no shift because E_C=0, contradicting the ordinary-degree Definition5.5. Separately, for a circle-weight-one complex line with trivial Z3 action, the stable presentations(S0,0) and(S^C,C) agree. The Thom class has degree2 and Euler restrictionU, so the printed plus-dimension normalization changes by4 while the correction c is fixed.
acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_boundary: Subtracting fixed-point level fixes the first local test but is absent from the displayed raw definition and does not fix the second, whose fixed levels are both0. Changing the plus sign to minus cancels the second tested shift. The second is a formal stable-presentation test, not a computed three-manifold spectral-window example. The field-label typo does not affect the degree0/2 test and is not counted separately.
acceptance_check.repair_check: Only the two local repairs and related class-degree bookkeeping in Proposition5.18 are checked. A simultaneous global normalization repair and every gauge-theory cutoff realization are unverified.
acceptance_check.severity_reason: Theorem5.20 explicitly uses Lemma5.15; Lemma6.1 uses Theorem5.20 and is invoked in the proof of Theorem1.1. The demonstrated invalid derivation therefore has direct core dependence and supports Major.

findings.title: Compatible higher fillers in Lemma 3.3
findings.method: Checked the displayed commuting-path and three-simplex calculation; examined what the algebraic relations alone imply.
findings.check: For an abstract topological-group model G≃ΩS², take τ=1 and a generator H of π1(G)=Z. The cyclic carry rule gives t∈H²(BZ_p;Z). Extension to BZ_p→BG≃S² would imply 0=f*(u²)=t², contradicting t²≠0 in H⁴(BZ_p;Z).
findings.alternative_readings: This is outside the manifold class and is not a counterexample to the actual collar data. Additional geometric structure may provide compatible higher fillers.
findings.required_evidence: An explicit all-dimensional compatible extension for the paper's collar homotopies, or a theorem with verified hypotheses supplying it.
findings.impact_limit: Unresolved validity of this step only; not promoted to a confirmed error or Major finding.

acceptance_check.claim_location: PDF pp.9-12 / printed217-220, especially Lemma3.3's higher-extension step onp11.
acceptance_check.decisive_check: In an abstract topological-group model G?OmegaS2, take tau=1 and H generating pi1(G)=Z. The carry cocycle c(i,j)=floor((i+j)/p) represents t in H2(BZp;Z). A compatible extension BZp?BG?S2 would pull a degree2 generator u back to t, forcing0=f*(u^2)=t^2, impossible in Z[t]/(pt). This shows that commuting-path relations alone are insufficient in arbitrary groups.
acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_boundary: The abstract example is outside the actual manifold/collar class. The explicit collar geometry may supply the extra compatible fillers. It is not a counterexample to the paper's construction and cannot be promoted to a confirmed error or used to raise severity.
acceptance_check.repair_check: An all-dimensional compatible collar extension, or an applicable theorem with verified hypotheses, remains unestablished in this focused check.

acceptance_summary: Retain the established Major grading-normalization defect and the separate Needs Evidence higher-coherence item. No falsity of the infinite-order or exoticness conclusion is established, and no global coordinated grading repair is certified.
acceptance_limits: The Section4 analytic/Fredholm/Conley-index construction and external Floer/lattice theorems were not independently rebuilt.
